areas.evidence_and_limits: Directories, mcpack/mcaddon, icons, UUID versions and dependency closure; atomic bounded imports.
Individual virtual datapacks; separate native Java/BP tabs; Create World and offline Edit World selections in level.dat.
Per-server immutable profiles, reload validation/rollback, subsystem prepare/open/tick/close, atomic namespaced world state.
Permanent actor/item Java hosts resolve world-owned logical Bedrock IDs; typed properties and item identity persist. Component semantics remain deferred.
Versioned server-scoped offer/request/chunks/ack, hashes, bounded decoding, cache, generation checks, timeout and disconnect cleanup.
Individual required world RPs reuse translation pipeline; logical actor/item rendering and synchronized client properties.
Integrated lifecycle and loopback dedicated connect/reconnect/removal tested; multi-client WAN and cross-version acceptance remain open.
No JavaScript VM, Script API endpoints, component/AI/event execution, Bedrock commands/functions, recipes/trades/loot or worldgen implementation.
